question: Does the U.S. Office of Financial Research supply full original-source daily systemic-financial-stress history and revision documentation across the 2011-2026 frozen Stage1 calendar, with category columns that may represent funding stress distinct from the old 39 price/VIX/breadth inputs?

official_context.published_data_lag: The OFR page says the FSI publishes data current from two business days prior. This is a current website statement, not historical first-receipt proof.
official_context.current_revision_warning: The page reports corrected May 2026 CEMBI feed dates; the current CSV may contain retrospective changes.
official_context.indicator_methodology_change: Official June 2023 release replaced seven reference-rate components effective from 2022-01-01. Do not assume the current full-history data were exactly the values available historically.

identity_gate: CSV HTTP200, valid header with date and numeric FSI-related fields, unique dates, at least one nonmissing numeric observation before 2011-01-03 and after 2026-10-07. Save exact rows and column names; do not choose a factor from source values. XLSX HTTP200 ZIP office workbook identity and nonempty revision text; if second request fails stop and archive received bytes.
conditional_second_request: Fetch revision workbook only after CSV passes transport, schema and full-span identity.
NAS_backup: Archive exact response bodies, headers, request/receipt UTC clocks, SHA-256 and source manifest; verify remote archive hash and scoped raw-member restore. Raw files local under data/snapshots only; no large CSV committed.
stop: Any transport/identity/coverage/NAS failure stops without source substitution. A successful source capture is retrospective availability only; next phase must pre-register a single column/formula, conservative publication lag, 2022 methodology transition and revision treatment, Qlib map and old39 redundancy before information fit. No 0bp account from this source-only card.
